---

## Engineering Task Shape Analysis — `ant-design/ant-design` @ `2f623fe` (antd v5.0.0–5.1.2, pre-2023 stratum)

The ancestry check confirmed `29ea546` is **not** an ancestor of `2f623fe`; the cutoff sits on a parallel line of history (likely a merge-base scenario). The analysis therefore covers the full file tree visible at `2f623fe`, cross-referenced against the CHANGELOG spanning v5.0.0–v5.1.2 (November–December 2022), which is the stratum of interest.

---

### 1. Feature — New top-level components

**Evidence:**

- [`components/app/index.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/app/index.tsx) — `App` component: wraps `useMessage`, `useNotification`, `useModal` into a single context provider (`AppContext`), exposing `App.useApp()`. This replaces the historically static-function-only imperative APIs (`message.success()`, etc.) with React-18-compatible hook-based alternatives. Zero prior art in the v4 tree for this exact pattern.

- [`components/qrcode/index.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/qrcode/index.tsx) — `QRCode` component wrapping `qrcode.react`, with `status` states (`active` / `loading` / `expired`), locale support, and `onRefresh` callback. New dependency `"qrcode.react": "^3.1.0"` in [`package.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/package.json?L119).

- [`components/watermark/index.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/watermark/index.tsx) — `Watermark`: renders a Canvas-based repeating watermark overlay. Uses [`useMutationObserver.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/watermark/useMutationObserver.ts) to detect and re-render when the DOM is tampered with (anti-removal guard). Entirely self-contained, no v4 equivalent.

- [`components/float-button/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/float-button) — `FloatButton`, `FloatButtonGroup`, `FloatButtonContent`, `BackTop` (refactored as a child); full compound component tree with CSS-in-JS styles, context for group shape, RTL support.

- [`components/tour/index.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/tour/index.tsx) — `Tour` wrapping `@rc-component/tour` with custom `panelRender`, theme integration, RTL, and a `_InternalPanelDoNotUseOrYouWillBeFired` escape hatch.

**Taxonomy verdict:** `feature` (new API surface, new user-visible functionality).

---

### 2. Architectural Scaffolding — CSS-in-JS Design Token system

This is the most structurally significant work in the stratum.

**Evidence:**

- [`components/theme/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/theme) — tri-algorithm token pipeline:
  - [`themes/default/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/theme/themes/default/index.ts) — `derivative()` maps `SeedToken → MapToken` via color palette generation, font scale, control height, spacing.
  - [`themes/dark/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/theme/themes/dark) and [`themes/compact/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/theme/themes/compact) — parallel derivative algorithms.
  - [`interface/alias.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/theme/interface/alias.ts) — `AliasToken` type extending `MapToken`, covering ~60 semantic tokens (colors, fonts, control sizes).
  - [`index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/theme/index.ts) — exports `{ useToken, defaultAlgorithm, darkAlgorithm, compactAlgorithm, defaultSeed }` as the public theme API.

- Every component now calls `useStyle(prefixCls)` — e.g., [`components/button/style/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/button/style/index.ts) — which invokes `genComponentStyleHook` from `@ant-design/cssinjs`, consuming alias tokens to produce scoped, hashed CSS. The entire less/CSS pipeline is gone (CHANGELOG v5.0.0: "Remove less and css in package").

- [`components/style/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/style) — shared style utilities: `compact-item.ts`, `compact-item-vertical.ts`, `roundedArrow.ts`, `placementArrow.ts`, `operationUnit.ts` — cross-component style primitives.

- [`components/_util/wave/WaveEffect.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/_util/wave/WaveEffect.tsx) — wave animation fully rewritten in React (`CSSMotion`, `render`/`unmount` from `rc-util`), dynamically computing `borderRadius`, `scale`, and `--wave-color` CSS custom properties from live DOM geometry. This allows multiple simultaneous wave triggers (CHANGELOG 5.1.2: "Refactor wave effect that can now trigger multiple times").

**Taxonomy verdict:** `architectural scaffolding` — establishes the foundational runtime styling infrastructure that all components depend on. This is category-spanning: it is simultaneously enabling infrastructure for every other task shape in the codebase.

### 3. Refactor — Component and API modernisation

**Evidence:**

- [`components/menu/MenuItem.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/menu/MenuItem.tsx) — `MenuItem` converted to a Function Component (CHANGELOG 5.1.0: "Refactor MenuItem to Function Component"). Uses `React.useContext(MenuContext)` and `SiderContext.Consumer`; prior class-based form is gone.

- [`components/locale-provider/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/locale-provider/index.ts) — reduced to a single-line re-export stub pointing at `../locale`. CHANGELOG 5.1.0 notes removal of `antd/es/locale-provider` and `antd/lib/locale-provider` folders. **Taxonomy verdict:** `refactor` with a cleanup dimension (deprecated surface eliminated).

### 4. Dependency Migration — Moment.js → Day.js; Less → `@ant-design/cssinjs`

**Evidence:**

- CHANGELOG v5.0.1: "Remove `Moment.js` dependency." [`package.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/package.json?L119) lists `"dayjs": "^1.11.1"` as a first-class dep; no `moment` entry anywhere in the manifest. [`package.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/package.json?L200) lists `"dumi": "^2.0.17"`; [`.dumirc.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.dumirc.ts) and [`.dumi/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/.dumi) directory confirm the migration.

### 5. Localized Bug Fix — Targeted per-component style and behaviour corrections

The densest task shape in the commit window. All entries are directly attributed to specific PR numbers in the CHANGELOG.

Representative examples by component:

| Component | Bug | Classification signal |
|---|---|---|
| Table | `column.filtered` cannot be updated; filter state persists after column change; fixed column transparent bg | State management, style regression |

| Form | Horizontal layout with `xs` responsive not working; validation motion flick | Layout and animation |
| Badge | Wave effect color not following `color` prop | Token propagation |
| Row | `justify`/`align` not reactive | Props reactivity |

**Taxonomy verdict:** `localized bug fix` — each is isolated to a single component, with no cross-component side effects.

### 7. Boilerplate — Per-component style module scaffolding

**Evidence:**

Every new component (`app`, `float-button`, `qrcode`, `tour`) follows an identical structural pattern:
```
<component>/
  index.tsx         — main component
  interface.ts      — prop type definitions
  context.ts        — React.createContext()
  style/index.ts    — genComponentStyleHook() call
  PurePanel.tsx     — internal preview/test escape hatch
  __tests__/        — test directory
  demo/             — demo .md files
  index.en-US.md    — API docs
  index.zh-CN.md    — Chinese docs
```

The `PurePanel` pattern (e.g., [`components/float-button/PurePanel.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/float-button/PurePanel.tsx), [`components/tour/PurePanel.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/tour/PurePanel.tsx)) is uniform across all components.

**Taxonomy verdict:** `boilerplate` — structural repetition generated by convention; not logic-carrying.

### 10. Cleanup

**Evidence:**

- `LocaleProvider` deprecated and its physical folders removed from published outputs; stub redirects remain for backward compat (see [`components/locale-provider/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/locale-provider/index.ts)).
- `dist/antd.css` removed; `dist/reset.css` added as a minimal override (CHANGELOG v5.0.0).
- IE and legacy browser removal from `browserslist` (CHANGELOG 5.1.1).
- `visible` and `dropdownClassName` props deprecated with console warnings via [`_util/warning.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/_util/warning.ts) rather than immediate removal — a controlled deprecation pattern.

**Taxonomy verdict:** `cleanup` — removal of dead/deprecated infrastructure, no new behaviour.

---

## Taxonomy Summary

| Task Shape | Confidence | Key Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Feature** | High | `App`, `QRCode`, `Watermark`, `FloatButton`, `Tour` components; new locale files; new theme API (`useToken`, algorithms) |
| **Architectural Scaffolding** | High | `components/theme/` token pipeline; per-component `useStyle`/`genComponentStyleHook`; `WaveEffect` React rewrite; `components/style/` shared primitives |
| **Refactor** | High | `MenuItem` → FC; `visible`→`open`, `dropdownClassName`→`popupClassName` renames; `LocaleProvider` internals moved to `locale/` |
| **Dependency Migration** | High | Moment.js → Day.js; Less → `@ant-design/cssinjs`; dumi v1 → v2 |
| **Localized Bug Fix** | High | ~30 discrete per-component fixes in CHANGELOG 5.0.1–5.1.2 |
| **Documentation/Configuration** | High | Bilingual changelogs + per-component `.md` docs; toolchain configs |
| **Boilerplate** | High | Structural scaffold repeated across all new components (`context.ts`, `style/index.ts`, `PurePanel.tsx`, `interface.ts`) |
| **Test Generation** | Medium | Per-component `__tests__/` suites with factory helpers; image regression tests |
| **Cleanup** | Medium | Deprecated API stubs; IE removal; `antd.css` removal |

**No taxonomy refinement proposed** — all observed task shapes map cleanly onto the provided categories. The only observation worth noting: the CSS-in-JS rewrite crosses the boundary between `dependency migration` (Less removed) and `architectural scaffolding` (token system introduced); it is properly classified as **architectural scaffolding** because the output is a new infrastructure layer, not a drop-in swap of an equivalent tool.

  - [`themes/default/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/theme/themes/default/index.ts) — `derivative()` maps `SeedToken → MapToken` via color palette generation, font scale, control height, spacing.
  - [`themes/dark/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/theme/themes/dark) and [`themes/compact/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/theme/themes/compact) — parallel derivative algorithms.
  - [`interface/alias.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/theme/interface/alias.ts) — `AliasToken` type extending `MapToken`, covering ~60 semantic tokens (colors, fonts, control sizes).
  - [`index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/theme/index.ts) — exports `{ useToken, defaultAlgorithm, darkAlgorithm, compactAlgorithm, defaultSeed }` as the public theme API.

- Every component now calls `useStyle(prefixCls)` — e.g., [`components/button/style/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/button/style/index.ts) — which invokes `genComponentStyleHook` from `@ant-design/cssinjs`, consuming alias tokens to produce scoped, hashed CSS. The entire less/CSS pipeline is gone (CHANGELOG v5.0.0: "Remove less and css in package").

- [`components/style/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/style) — shared style utilities: `compact-item.ts`, `compact-item-vertical.ts`, `roundedArrow.ts`, `placementArrow.ts`, `operationUnit.ts` — cross-component style primitives.

- [`components/_util/wave/WaveEffect.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/_util/wave/WaveEffect.tsx) — wave animation fully rewritten in React (`CSSMotion`, `render`/`unmount` from `rc-util`), dynamically computing `borderRadius`, `scale`, and `--wave-color` CSS custom properties from live DOM geometry. This allows multiple simultaneous wave triggers (CHANGELOG 5.1.2: "Refactor wave effect that can now trigger multiple times").

**Taxonomy verdict:** `architectural scaffolding` — establishes the foundational runtime styling infrastructure that all components depend on. This is category-spanning: it is simultaneously enabling infrastructure for every other task shape in the codebase.

---

### 3. Refactor — Component and API modernisation

**Evidence:**

- [`components/menu/MenuItem.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/menu/MenuItem.tsx) — `MenuItem` converted to a Function Component (CHANGELOG 5.1.0: "Refactor MenuItem to Function Component"). Uses `React.useContext(MenuContext)` and `SiderContext.Consumer`; prior class-based form is gone.

- [`components/locale-provider/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/locale-provider/index.ts) — reduced to a single-line re-export stub pointing at `../locale`. The real locale logic now lives in [`components/locale/index.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/locale/index.tsx) with a deprecation warning via `_ANT_MARK__`. CHANGELOG 5.1.0 notes removal of `antd/es/locale-provider` and `antd/lib/locale-provider` folders. **Taxonomy verdict:** `refactor` with a cleanup dimension (deprecated surface eliminated).

- `visible` → `open` prop rename across Drawer, Modal, Dropdown, Tooltip, Popover, Popconfirm, Tag, Table (`filterDropdownVisible` → `filterDropdownOpen`) — systematic API surface normalisation. CHANGELOG v5.0.0 lists six separate components. This is a **refactor** at the API contract layer, not a behaviour change.

- `dropdownClassName` → `popupClassName` rename across AutoComplete, Mentions, Cascader, Select, TreeSelect, DatePicker, TimePicker. Same shape.

**Taxonomy verdict:** `refactor` (behaviour-preserving restructuring of component internals and public API naming).

### 4. Dependency Migration — Moment.js → Day.js; Less → `@ant-design/cssinjs`

**Evidence:**

- CHANGELOG v5.0.1: "Remove `Moment.js` dependency." [`package.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/package.json?L119) lists `"dayjs": "^1.11.1"` as a first-class dep; no `moment` entry anywhere in the manifest. Date-picker's [`generatePicker/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/components/date-picker/generatePicker) abstraction allows plugging in any day.js-compatible library.

- Less build pipeline removed (CHANGELOG v5.0.0: "Remove less and css in package"). `@ant-design/cssinjs` appears as a production dependency in `package.json`; `stylelint` remains only in devDependencies for lint of the remaining `.css` reset file.

- Site tooling: CHANGELOG v5.0.0: "Migrate official site to dumi@2." [`package.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/package.json?L200) lists `"dumi": "^2.0.17"`; [`.dumirc.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.dumirc.ts) and [`.dumi/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/tree/.dumi) directory confirm the migration.

- CHANGELOG 5.1.0: "Simplified lodash method introduction" — targeted tree-shaking of lodash imports, reducing bundle scope.

**Taxonomy verdict:** `dependency migration` (runtime and build-time dependency swap with consequent API adaptation).

### 5. Localized Bug Fix — Targeted per-component style and behaviour corrections

The densest task shape in the commit window. All entries are directly attributed to specific PR numbers in the CHANGELOG.

Representative examples by component:

| Component | Bug | Classification signal |
|---|---|---|
| Table | `column.filtered` cannot be updated; filter state persists after column change; fixed column transparent bg | State management, style regression |
| Image | Preview bar covered during animation; TailwindCSS conflict | CSS specificity / z-index |
| Slider | Missing Tooltip animation; missing Tooltip appear motion | Animation state regression |
| QRCode | Missing expired style | Style omission |
| Tree | Switcher background in dark theme | Theme token application |
| Menu | Slide bar style when border reset; SubMenu flicker with `createRoot`; icon animation on collapse | CSS-in-JS token, React 18 concurrency edge case |
| Checkbox | Tooltip/Popover blocked when disabled | Event/DOM wrapping regression |
| Drawer | Default props not working when props are `undefined` | Props merging logic |
| Form | Horizontal layout with `xs` responsive not working; validation motion flick | Layout and animation |
| Badge | Wave effect color not following `color` prop | Token propagation |
| Row | `justify`/`align` not reactive | Props reactivity |

**Taxonomy verdict:** `localized bug fix` — each is isolated to a single component, with no cross-component side effects.

### 7. Boilerplate — Per-component style module scaffolding

**Evidence:**

Every new component (`app`, `float-button`, `qrcode`, `tour`) follows an identical structural pattern:
```
<component>/
  index.tsx         — main component
  interface.ts      — prop type definitions
  context.ts        — React.createContext()
  style/index.ts    — genComponentStyleHook() call
  PurePanel.tsx     — internal preview/test escape hatch
  __tests__/        — test directory
  demo/             — demo .md files
  index.en-US.md    — API docs
  index.zh-CN.md    — Chinese docs
```

The `PurePanel` pattern (e.g., [`components/float-button/PurePanel.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/float-button/PurePanel.tsx), [`components/tour/PurePanel.tsx`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/tour/PurePanel.tsx)) is uniform across all components.

**Taxonomy verdict:** `boilerplate` — structural repetition generated by convention; not logic-carrying.

### 10. Cleanup

**Evidence:**

- `LocaleProvider` deprecated and its physical folders removed from published outputs; stub redirects remain for backward compat (see [`components/locale-provider/index.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/locale-provider/index.ts)).
- `dist/antd.css` removed; `dist/reset.css` added as a minimal override (CHANGELOG v5.0.0).
- IE and legacy browser removal from `browserslist` (CHANGELOG 5.1.1).
- `visible` and `dropdownClassName` props deprecated with console warnings via [`_util/warning.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/components/_util/warning.ts) rather than immediate removal — a controlled deprecation pattern.

**Taxonomy verdict:** `cleanup` — removal of dead/deprecated infrastructure, no new behaviour.

---

## Taxonomy Summary

| Task Shape | Confidence | Key Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Feature** | High | `App`, `QRCode`, `Watermark`, `FloatButton`, `Tour` components; new locale files; new theme API (`useToken`, algorithms) |
| **Architectural Scaffolding** | High | `components/theme/` token pipeline; per-component `useStyle`/`genComponentStyleHook`; `WaveEffect` React rewrite; `components/style/` shared primitives |
| **Refactor** | High | `MenuItem` → FC; `visible`→`open`, `dropdownClassName`→`popupClassName` renames; `LocaleProvider` internals moved to `locale/` |
| **Dependency Migration** | High | Moment.js → Day.js; Less → `@ant-design/cssinjs`; dumi v1 → v2 |
| **Localized Bug Fix** | High | ~30 discrete per-component fixes in CHANGELOG 5.0.1–5.1.2 |
| **Documentation/Configuration** | High | Bilingual changelogs + per-component `.md` docs; toolchain configs |
| **Boilerplate** | High | Structural scaffold repeated across all new components (`context.ts`, `style/index.ts`, `PurePanel.tsx`, `interface.ts`) |
| **Test Generation** | Medium | Per-component `__tests__/` suites with factory helpers; image regression tests |
| **Cleanup** | Medium | Deprecated API stubs; IE removal; `antd.css` removal |

**No taxonomy refinement proposed** — all observed task shapes map cleanly onto the provided categories. The only observation worth noting: the CSS-in-JS rewrite crosses the boundary between `dependency migration` (Less removed) and `architectural scaffolding` (token system introduced); it is properly classified as **architectural scaffolding** because the output is a new infrastructure layer, not a drop-in swap of an equivalent tool.
